Industrial property for sale and lease in South Surrey: warehouses, industrial buildings, shop condos and industrial strata units listed on the MLS®. Space for lease is included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.
Where South Surrey’s industrial land is

items.t: Campbell Heights Business Park covers 1,900 acres along Surrey’s eastern edge by the Langley border. It is home to 495 businesses and more than 12,600 jobs, and its zoning is mainly IB-1 and IB-2 business park. ([City of Surrey, Campbell Heights Business Park](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/CampbellHeightsBusinessPark.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

Campbell Heights is Surrey’s largest industrial area in the regional inventory (770 hectares), and it had the region’s largest addition of new industrial parcels between 2020 and 2025 (154.4 hectares). ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

South Campbell Heights, approved by Council on December 16, 2024, adds about 249 hectares (615 acres) south of the existing park, about 350 acres of it employment land. ([City of Surrey, South Campbell Heights plan](https://www.surrey.ca/renovating-building-development/land-planning-development/land-use-planning/south-surrey-land-use-plans/south-campbell-heights), read November 20, 2026)

BC Hydro’s new 230 kV Brookswood substation, a $450 million investment, is planned for 2033 to serve growth in the area. ([City of Surrey, Campbell Heights Business Park](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/CampbellHeightsBusinessPark.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

The Douglas Industrial Area (26 acres) sits at the Pacific border crossing and holds 113 businesses, including customs brokers and logistics companies. ([City of Surrey, Douglas Industrial Area](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/DouglasIndustrialArea.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: In the second quarter of 2026, 19 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were industrial properties, against 81 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only South Surrey.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Surrey submarket (45.1M sq ft) was 4.2% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $19.66 per sq ft net plus $6.95 in additional rent, with 1,628,917 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey and White Rock zones that allow industrial uses

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside South Surrey. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.
